q1: SELECT MAX(NUM) AS NUM FROM (SELECT NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) = 1) AS T
q2: WITH ALT AS ( SELECT NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ) SELECT MAX(NUM) NUM FROM ALT
